portal.manualCodeHelp: Ask the customer to show the code on their Wallet screen.
portal.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR code on the customer's screen.
portal.scanUnavailable: Camera isn't available on this device. Use the "Enter code" tab below.
portal.scanPermissionDenied: Camera permission was denied. Use the "Enter code" tab below, or allow camera access in your browser settings.
portal.scanNoCamera: No camera was found. Use the "Enter code" tab below.
portal.notFoundBody: No voucher matches that code. Double check it with the customer, or ask them to reopen the voucher page in their Wallet.
portal.unreadableBody: That code couldn't be verified — the screen may have moved or the code may have just rotated. Ask the customer to hold their screen steady and scan again, or enter the code manually.
portal.amountHelp: The value of the customer's purchase to deduct from this voucher.
portal.cantRedeemOfflineBody: This device has no connection right now. Nothing has been charged — try again when connected.

voucherNotFound.heading: Voucher not found
voucherNotFound.body: That code doesn't match any voucher. Double-check it with the customer.

alreadyRedeemed.heading: Voucher already redeemed
alreadyRedeemed.body: This voucher has already been used and can't be redeemed again. Ask the customer for another voucher or a different payment method.

expired.heading: Voucher expired
expired.body: This voucher expired on {date} and can't be redeemed. Let the customer know it's no longer valid.

amountNotPositive.heading: Invalid amount
amountNotPositive.body: Enter an amount greater than zero.

amountExceedsRemainingValue.heading: Amount exceeds the voucher's remaining value
amountExceedsRemainingValue.body: This voucher only has {remaining} remaining. Reduce the amount, or ask the customer to pay the difference another way.

requiresFullValueRedemption.heading: This voucher must be redeemed in full
requiresFullValueRedemption.body: This voucher must be redeemed for its full remaining value of {remaining}.

networkError.heading: Redemption couldn't be processed
networkError.body: A network problem interrupted this redemption. The voucher has not been charged — try again.

provisioning.unlockPinHelp: This PIN only locks this device's screen while it's not in use — it isn't a personal account. Anyone at the shop who knows it can use it.
provisioning.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

form.heading: Pair this device
form.intro: Ask your business's Admin for a pairing code — it's generated from Studio → Team → Devices and binds this device to one shop location. Your Admin also sets this device's PIN there.

errors.invalidCode: That code wasn't recognised. Check it with your Admin.
errors.revoked: Your business's Admin has revoked this device's access. Ask them for a new pairing code.
